build_DeepSeekV32ToolParser: build a DeepSeekV32ToolParser instance with a tokenizer and optional tools list to parse DeepSeek-style tool calls
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from complete non-streaming model output containing DSML invoke blocks
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract tool calls incrementally from streaming model output using buffer-until-complete-invoke strategy
adjust_request: adjust a ChatCompletionRequest or ResponsesRequest to ensure tool call tokens are not skipped during decoding
convert_param_value: convert a raw string parameter value to the correct Python type using the tool schema definition
